subject: Request to temporarily stall promotion of Aurora-Lite v2
messages:
From: Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.ai>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Acme AI <ops@acme.ai>, Acme Procurement <procurement@acme.ai>, Sarah Nguyen <sarah@acme.ai>
Date: Tue, 3 Nov 2026 09:05:00 -0700
Subject: Request to temporarily stall promotion of Aurora-Lite v2

Team / Acme —

Quick summary: we observed a small but consistent uptick in perplexity drift and a spike in token CPU on canary for Aurora-Lite v2 between 10k–20k tokens. Telemetry (attached) shows the signal on three separate canary hosts. Before we promote the variant to the wider pool for Acme's production route, I want to ask for a short stall (24–48h) to: 

- run a focused PQE rerun against Acme's prompt set,
- push a minor tokenizer patch candidate that Laura prepared, and
- extend the canary window to capture peak usage tonight in US-PST.

Why now: Acme's acceptance plan has a tight window next week and we want to avoid a rollback. This is a low-risk delay but gives us a chance to validate that the tokenizer patch mitigates the drift.

Attachments: aurora-lite-v2-telemetry.csv, rollout-plan-v1.pdf

Request: Marcus/Karthik/Marissa — can you confirm whether we can stall promotion for up to 48 hours and push the patch candidate into the canary lane? Laura — can you attach a short test matrix for the tokenizer patch (latency, tokenization diffs, regression checks)?

Acme: Sarah/procurement — apologies for the interruption. This is a precautionary hold; we'll aim to keep it as brief as possible and will share an updated plan + rollback criteria within the day.

Thanks,
Naomi
Naomi Feldman
Program Manager, Model Intake
Redwood Inference
naomi_feldman@redwood.ai
From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Acme AI <ops@acme.ai>
Date: Tue, 3 Nov 2026 10:11:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request to temporarily stall promotion of Aurora-Lite v2

+1 to a short stall. I've checked capacity impact: holding canary promotion for 48h is fine from throughput scheduling perspective and won't block other customer rollouts.

Two operational asks from my side: 
1) If we extend the canary window tonight, let's enable token-level tracing on one host to capture the micro-latency spikes (we can disable after 6 hours).
2) If the tokenizer patch changes tokenization boundaries, we need to re-run the sampling evaluator and update the baseline artifacts in S3 (Laura, can you confirm S3 path and size estimate?).

I'll stand by to approve the patch canary once Laura provides the test matrix.

- Marcus
Marcus Lin
SRE Lead, Serving Runtime
marcus_lin@redwood.ai
From: Sarah Nguyen <sarah@acme.ai>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
Cc: Acme Procurement <procurement@acme.ai>
Date: Tue, 3 Nov 2026 13:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request to temporarily stall promotion of Aurora-Lite v2

Hi Naomi / Marcus —

Thanks for the heads-up. We prefer there be no user-visible regressions during the acceptance window; a 48h stall is acceptable on our side as long as you provide clear rollback criteria and a go/no-go checklist. Procurement: we understand this is a technical hold and do not need contract changes.

Please confirm: will this stall push the final promotion past Acme's cutover on Thu 11/5? If so we need to adjust our internal communications.

Best,
Sarah Nguyen
Head of ML Ops, Acme AI
sarah@acme.ai
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Acme AI <ops@acme.ai>
Date: Tue, 3 Nov 2026 16:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request to temporarily stall promotion of Aurora-Lite v2

Thanks — I support the hold. Quick plan proposal (action items with owners and ETA):

1) Laura: deliver the tokenizer patch test matrix + S3 artifact path by 18:45 PT (today). Should include token-diff heatmap, latency delta, and sample regen instructions.
2) Marcus: enable token tracing on canary host and share trace after 6h (ETA 22:30 PT).
3) Marissa: run PQE sampling for Acme prompt set with the patch on staging and report quality metrics (ETA 06:00 PT Wed).
4) Naomi: prepare a one-page go/no-go checklist for Acme with rollback triggers and expected timeline (ETA 19:30 PT).

If all checks are green we can promote after the extended canary window tonight but no later than 12:00 PT Wed to avoid impacting Acme's cutover. If any check fails we roll back to the previous variant and notify Acme procurement.

Also note: Marissa, we may need a short emergency rollback runbook added to the Console route (how to pin route back to previous variant within 3m). Please prepare that as well.

Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Product Manager, Model Safety & Stability
karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
From: Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.ai>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Sarah Nguyen <sarah@acme.ai>, Acme Procurement <procurement@acme.ai>
Date: Tue, 3 Nov 2026 17:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request to temporarily stall promotion of Aurora-Lite v2

Acknowledged and thanks everyone for the quick responses. I'll draft the one-page go/no-go checklist and share in this thread (and in the Drive link) by 19:30 PT. Laura — ping me when the matrix is uploaded and I'll trigger the PQE run.

Sarah: short answer — if checks pass, promotion will be completed before 12:00 PT Wed 11/4. If we need to fail, we'll roll back immediately and share the postmortem. We'll confirm timing in the checklist.

Action summary in thread: three deliverables (tokenizer matrix, token traces, PQE run) + Naomi checklist + Marissa rollback runbook.

I'll update HS-ACME-3421 after we've promoted or rolled back.

Thanks,
Naomi
Program Manager, Model Intake
Redwood Inference
naomi_feldman@redwood.ai
